coaching.headline: Dominant 23-14 kills and 72,594-to-0 objective damage won it despite two solo deaths costing a tower pair and inhibitor.
coaching.team: Drongo held the duo lane favored all game against Sparrow, while mid, offlane, support and jungle all read unfavored or split against Howitzer, Greystone, Dekker and Countess. We still won the kill count 23-14, the tower count 7-6, and ran up 72,594 objective damage to the enemy's zero — every enemy player finished with zero damage to a structure. The only sour stretch was a pair of solo catches at 22.9 and 25.2, which gave up an Outer Tower pair, an Inner Tower and an Inhibitor inside three minutes. Everywhere else we converted: three fights won, three cashed into Genesis Core, Orb Prime and their Inhibitor, against the one fight we lost at 16.5 near our Outer Tower, which they took moments later. The 32.2 full-squad ace took their Inhibitor and opened the door to the Core that closed the game at 34 minutes.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Two solo catches cost four structures in three minutes — an Outer Tower pair, an Inner Tower and an Inhibitor. The squad answered with the 32.2 ace, catching all five of them and opening the Core.
coaching.whatWorked: We won three fights and converted every one into Genesis Core, Orb Prime, or their Inhibitor; they converted zero of their one win beyond that single tower.

focus.title: Up a body, still an even trade
focus.evidence: At 24.1 we had the man advantage, a 5v4, and still traded 2-2 instead of cleaning it up.
focus.action: When a fight opens with an extra body, focus the lone free target down fast instead of trading evenly — a man advantage that only trades even is a wasted lead.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.3s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Adele, Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down
